values.display: automatically publishes (sends) findings as events to Amazon EventBridge

evidence.quote: GuardDuty creates an event when there is a change in the findings.

GuardDuty automatically publishes (sends) findings as events to Amazon EventBridge (formerly Amazon CloudWatch Events), a serverless event bus service. EventBridge delivers a stream of near real-time data from applications and services to targets such as Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics, AWS Lambda functions, and Amazon Kinesis streams.
